title: RawConfigV1
description: The konpy.json file as written (conventions may be references).

ClassDefinitionV1.description: A class reference, optionally extending a base and implementing interfaces.
ClassDefinitionV1.title: ClassDefinitionV1

ConventionUseRefV1.description: A top-level convention entry that references a reusable convention by name.
ConventionUseRefV1.title: ConventionUseRefV1

DeclarationDefinitionV1.description: A bare name reference to a declared type, constant, or function.
DeclarationDefinitionV1.title: DeclarationDefinitionV1

ExportDefinitionV1.description: An export reference: a bare name, optionally re-exported from another module.
ExportDefinitionV1.title: ExportDefinitionV1

ExtendObjectV1.description: A base-type reference with an ``allowOmissions`` escape hatch.
ExtendObjectV1.title: ExtendObjectV1

ForV1.description: Scopes a ``must``/``mustNot`` block to a subset of files within a convention's paths.
ForV1.title: ForV1

FunctionDefinitionV1.description: A function/method signature reference used by declare/export predicates.
FunctionDefinitionV1.title: FunctionDefinitionV1

HasFileConditionV1.description: A condition satisfied when the given file exists.
HasFileConditionV1.title: HasFileConditionV1

ImportDefinitionV1.description: An import reference: a bare name, optionally imported from another module.
ImportDefinitionV1.title: ImportDefinitionV1

InterfaceDefinitionV1.description: An interface/protocol reference, optionally extending another type.
InterfaceDefinitionV1.title: InterfaceDefinitionV1

MustBlockUseRefV1.description: A ``must``/``mustNot`` block that references a reusable convention by name.
MustBlockUseRefV1.title: MustBlockUseRefV1

MustPredicatesV1.description: The full set of predicates a convention's ``must``/``mustNot`` block may declare.
MustPredicatesV1.title: MustPredicatesV1

PlaceholderSatisfiesConditionV1.description: A condition satisfied when a placeholder value matches a pattern.
PlaceholderSatisfiesConditionV1.title: PlaceholderSatisfiesConditionV1

RawHandWrittenConventionV1.description: A hand-written convention as it appears in ``konpy.json``, before expansion.
RawHandWrittenConventionV1.title: RawHandWrittenConventionV1

forbid.description: Star-pattern base class paths to forbid (written or resolved form).
forbid.title: Forbid

allow.description: Star-pattern base class paths that override a forbid match.
allow.title: Allow

forbid.description: Star-pattern callee paths to forbid (written or resolved form).
forbid.title: Forbid

allow.description: Star-pattern callee paths that override a forbid match.
allow.title: Allow

scope.description: When "module", only check call sites that run at import time: module-level statements and class-body statements (class bodies execute when the class is defined). When "any", check calls at every scope, including inside function bodies.
scope.title: Scope

forbid.description: Star-pattern decorator paths to forbid (written or resolved form).
forbid.title: Forbid

allow.description: Star-pattern decorator paths that override a forbid match.
allow.title: Allow

minStatements.description: Minimum normalized statement count before a function is considered.
minStatements.title: Minstatements

publicOnly.description: When true, skip private functions and methods.
publicOnly.title: Publiconly

allowNames.description: Star-pattern function names, qualified names, or file::qualified_name labels to ignore.
allowNames.title: Allownames

maxLines.description: Maximum allowed physical line count for a matched file.
maxLines.title: Maxlines

forbid.description: Star-pattern import paths to forbid, matched against the import's source module or its full symbol path.
forbid.title: Forbid

allow.description: Star-pattern import paths that override a forbid match.
allow.title: Allow

scope.description: Restrict which imports are checked by where they execute: "module" for top-level imports only, "function" for imports nested inside a function body only, or "any" for both.
scope.title: Scope

includeTypeChecking.description: When false (the default), imports guarded by `if TYPE_CHECKING:` are skipped. Set true to check them too.
includeTypeChecking.title: Includetypechecking

minLength.description: Minimum decoded string length before a literal is considered.
minLength.title: Minlength

maxOccurrences.description: Maximum allowed occurrences of one literal in the matched scope.
maxOccurrences.title: Maxoccurrences

allow.description: Star-pattern string literal values to ignore.
allow.title: Allow

UnusedCodeV1.description:
Optional ``unusedCode`` rule config (M10 unused-code detection).

All fields are optional; engine-level defaults and framework presets are
applied in ``konpy.unused.engine`` rather than in this model.
UnusedCodeV1.title: UnusedCodeV1

VerifyConfigV1.description:
Optional ``verify`` roster config, run by ``konpy verify``.

A child config's ``verify`` section replaces its parent's wholesale under
``extends`` -- unlike ``unusedCode``, whose individual fields merge one by
one -- because this model has a single list field, and the generic
inheritance merge never merges list values, only replaces them.
VerifyConfigV1.title: VerifyConfigV1

VerifyStepV1.description: One named step in a ``konpy verify`` roster, run to completion in order.
VerifyStepV1.title: VerifyStepV1
